hikes.name: Sherman Peak
hikes.blurb: Along the Kettle Crest through old burns and meadows to a summit over the empty northeast corner.

hikes.name: Bald Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Barnaby Buttes Trailhead, an 11.9-mile round trip to the top of Bald Mountain (6,332 ft), with about 3,650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Emerald Lake
hikes.blurb: From Hoodoo Canyon, a 5.5-mile round trip to Emerald Lake, with about 1,800 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Scar Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Old Stage, a 10.0-mile round trip to the top of Scar Mountain (7,139 ft), with about 2,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Barnaby Buttes
hikes.blurb: From Barnaby Buttes Trailhead, a 7.2-mile round trip to the top of Barnaby Buttes (6,487 ft), with about 2,100 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Wapaloosie Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Sherman Trailhead, an 8.5-mile round trip to the top of Wapaloosie Mountain (6,868 ft), with about 2,050 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Thirteenmile Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Nine Mile Falls Trailhead, a 9.4-mile round trip to the top of Thirteenmile Mountain (4,604 ft), with about 2,000 feet of climbing.
